channel.title: AI Threat Watch: RU
channel.description: Verified case files located in RU.

item.title: [LOW] Deepfake of Smolensk governor Vasily Anokhin urges foreign airlines to protect crews over Russian airspace
item.description: A neural-network-generated video circulated online in which Smolensk Oblast governor Vasily Anokhin appeared to urge foreign airlines flying through Russian airspace to look after their crews. Anokhin said in his Max channel that he made no such address and that the video was fake. The creators are unidentified and no financial loss or scam scheme has been reported. Target: Vasily Anokhin, governor of Smolensk Oblast (impersonated); the public. RU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Russian MVD warns fake online stores may use AI-generated celebrity videos to lure buyers
item.description: Russia's Interior Ministry cybercrime directorate warned on 27 October 2026 that fake online shops advertising steep discounts or foreign delivery may use AI-generated videos of well-known people to look convincing. Buyers are asked to prepay in full and the goods never arrive, with the sellers blaming customs delays and keeping the money. The MVD gave no victim numbers, losses or arrests. Target: Online shoppers. RU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] St Petersburg ballet master Komleva sells flat for 9.1M rubles after calls from AI avatar of Governor Beglov
item.description: Scammers reportedly used an AI avatar of St Petersburg governor Alexander Beglov, plus a man posing as a first deputy interior minister, in messenger video calls to convince Mariinsky Theatre ballet master Gabriela Komleva, 87, to sell her Tsarskoye Selo flat for 9.1M rubles (December 2024) and hand the proceeds to them. She realised the deception months later and went to police; the case became public via a court ruling that let the buyer keep the flat. Target: Gabriela Komleva, 87, Mariinsky Theatre ballet master, St Petersburg. RU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Pensioner in Ust-Ilimsk loses 26M rubles to scammers using a 'digital double' of Irkutsk governor Kobzev, officials say
item.description: Governor Igor Kobzev said scammers used his 'digital double' to deceive a pensioner in Ust-Ilimsk, Irkutsk Oblast, who handed over 26 million rubles, nearly all her savings, in late October 2026. Media reports describe a copied voice and a video call, and police say a further 6 million rubles was saved. The AI technique has not been independently verified. Target: Pensioner in Ust-Ilimsk, Irkutsk Oblast, Russia. RU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Fake 'Solidity Language' extension on Open VSX drains $500K from Cursor developer
item.description: A spoofed Solidity extension on Open VSX, ranked above the real one through inflated downloads, ran a PowerShell script that installed ScreenConnect, Quasar RAT and a stealer, letting attackers take a developer's seed phrases and about 500,000 dollars in crypto. Target: Cursor IDE users installing Solidity extensions. RU. Verification: confirmed.
